page.overview:
Who is Caoli?

In the wake of Dairin's death in 295 BG at the hands of Yun and the coinciding eruption of political turmoil threatening to plunge the Fire Nation into civil war, Caoli, Dairin's former student, succeeded him as chancellor and Head Palace Historian. Caoli became a key player in cementing how the details of the conflict would be remembered. Caoli spent many long days in the tower study with Zoryu crafting how future generations of Fire Nation citizens would view this period of history. At Caoli's suggestion, the feud would come to be known as the Camellia-Peony War,

Caoli was an imaginative historian who had a talent for wordplay and pivotal influence on the Fire Lord in the weeks following his staged apprehension of Yun's impostor. Caoli impressed Zoryu with the poetic beauty of the name "Camellia-Peony War" despite the actual events never escalating into all-out war.
